interpretation: Synthetic decision-analysis weights for Helix development. They are not estimates of real-bank monetary loss, staffing cost, customer harm, or production traffic economics.

event_semantics.correct_route: Automatically routed to the correct intent.
event_semantics.wrong_intent_same_queue: Automatic intent prediction is wrong but predicted and true intents belong to the same frozen operational queue.
event_semantics.wrong_queue: Automatic prediction sends an in-domain case to a different operational queue, or automatically routes a frozen synthetic OOS request instead of escalating it.
event_semantics.unsafe_high_risk_auto_route: Automatic intent prediction is wrong when the true in-domain intent is marked high_risk in routing-operations-v1. This overrides same-queue and wrong-queue error costs.
event_semantics.human_escalation: The router abstains and sends the request to human review. This is the unit-cost anchor.

population_mixture.oos_distribution: uniform empirical distribution over the 160 frozen synthetic routing-oos-v1 queries
population_mixture.limitation: OOS prevalence and synthetic-query mixture are scenario assumptions, not estimates of production traffic.

policy.automatic_route_rule: AUTO_ROUTE when confidence >= threshold; otherwise escalate. For frozen OOS queries, automatic routing is scored as wrong_queue and escalation as human_escalation.
policy.threshold_candidates: all unique observed confidence values plus 0 and 1
policy.primary_selection: minimum expected cost under balanced_risk_v1 and 10% OOS prevalence

comparisons.H3_development: Compare each surviving model raw versus temperature-scaled confidence under the same frozen cost assumptions; primary endpoint is minimum expected routing cost.
comparisons.H4_development: Report selective risk at fixed coverage and the cost-selected operating point versus full automation.
